title: Stylometry for Noisy Medieval Data: Evaluating Paul Meyer's Hagiographic Hypothesis
findings: The study's stylometric analysis largely confirms Paul Meyer's hypothesis that the hagiographic collection in MS BnF, fr. 412 was formed by successive additions (Collections A, B, C). The findings also refine this hypothesis by identifying new sub-series, reclassifying certain texts (e.g., Saint Longin's Life from A to B), and raising new questions about authorship, such as the potential attribution of Saint Lambert's life to Wauchier de Denain.
